Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
657 AM EST Fri Nov 6 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM LATE TONIGHT THROUGH SATURDAY
AFTERNOON...

.TODAY...SW winds 10 kt...becoming N late this morning and early
afternoon, then becoming E late. Waves 1 ft. Patchy fog this
morning. Showers and scattered tstms this morning, then isolated
showers this afternoon. Vsby 1 NM or less this morning. 
.TONIGHT...SE winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming W late in the evening,
then becoming NW 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 25 kt after midnight.
Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.SAT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...W winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 to
3 ft. 
.SUN...W winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SUN NIGHT...W winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt...becoming W 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 to
2 ft. 
.TUE...W winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
